scripts.build:win32: cmake-js compile --runtime node --runtime-version 22.22.2 --arch ia32 --out build/ia32 && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('prebuilds/win32-ia32',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('build/ia32/Release/printer_engine_node.node','prebuilds/win32-ia32/printer_engine_node.node')"
scripts.build:win64: cmake-js compile --runtime node --runtime-version 24.14.1 --arch x64 --out build/x64 && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('prebuilds/win32-x64',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('build/x64/Release/printer_engine_node.node','prebuilds/win32-x64/printer_engine_node.node')"
scripts.build:windows: npm run build:win32 && npm run build:win64
